objective.primary_from_protocol: Convergence of Q3/Q4 all-domain threshold events against finer numerical references under fixed physics, subject to mass/positivity/boundary and Q1 Bessel checks.
objective.cost: Measured wall-clock seconds; runtime is secondary to valid numerical evidence, not a global optimum claim.
not_objectives: Minimize drying time by altering physical parameters
Maximize invented predictive accuracy without internal measured T/C
Match peer prestige or an expected 2-3 day duration

budget.record_scope: Recorded protocol limit; not evidence of an identical hard timeout in every early driver.
budget.later_revision: 15:49 UTC: full-second field differences required Q1/Q23 N3200 and Q4 N3200/6400; memory limitation led to disk storage and sequential runs.

common_constraints: Original environmental/radius data and units retained; no internal T/C truth fabricated.
Q1 Appendix 2; Q2/Q3 Appendix 3 from t=0; Q4 Appendix 4 from t=0, exogenous observed R(t), affine radial material map.
rho_eff used only in effective thermal storage; dry-matter moisture conservation is a separately declared closure.
Same initial T=301.15 K and C=2.55 kg/kg, h=25 and beta=8e-7 in numerical baseline; same nominal post-4h boundary 50 degC / 0.05.
Numerical candidates change discretization/Jacobian/storage/N/time settings within their declared series. Physical parameter/boundary changes form separate scenario families.

summary.validation_criteria: Both heat refinements and 100-to-400 frozen-water refinement reduce max error; N400 sampled max errors below 1e-4 in physical units.
summary.scope: Numerical verification against the selected constant-coefficient PDE; no internal experimental accuracy claim.
summary.point_value_comparison: Nodal-dual state is compared to exact point values at the same physical radii. Separate representation diagnostics quantify strict annular averages.
summary.nonlinear_moisture_note: The nonlinear Q1 C solution is stored for provenance only, not compared with constant-D Bessel or labeled analytic truth.

core_static_review.water_face_flux: Internal face radius times D0*exp(-3850/T_face)*(F(C_right)-F(C_left))/dx, with no thermal factor in the differenced potential.
core_static_review.Q1_temperature_factor: Exactly one, since D1 has no temperature dependence.
core_static_review.internal_flux_cancellation: Each face occurs with opposite signs in adjacent control-volume balances; weighted sum leaves only the surface flux.
core_static_review.density_interpretation: rho*cp is effective thermal capacity; independent dry-matter weighting is used for conserved moisture.
core_static_review.scope_limitation: Static consistency and linear benchmark do not alone validate all nonlinear long-time or shrinkage scenarios.

summary.scope: Storage-only identity check on three complete N40 trajectories; not spatial accuracy validation
Storage-only identity check on three complete N40 trajectories; not spatial accuracy validation

limitations: This is a local-core recomputation, not execution or reproduction of peer code.
Only beta factors 1 and 2 and grids 200/400/800 are tested; no optimal beta is identified.
Profile comparisons are at saved common times, not every continuous time.
Quality checks and mass conservation do not prove event or field convergence.
Full heat/moisture coupling is not automatically covered by a scalar comparison theorem.
GUI reproduction and human review are pending; production choice is not changed.
